summary: Access request: grant Devon Price "release-signing-operator" role for offline bundle signing pipeline
description:
Request type: Privileged access / RBAC role assignment

Requestor: Connor O'Brien (Release Engineering)
Target user: Devon Price (Release tooling implementer)
System: Signing service operator RBAC (release signing workflow for Redwood Private offline bundles)
Role requested: release-signing-operator
Requested duration: 90 days (until end of pilot + GA hardening)

Business justification:
Devon needs to operate and validate the new offline bundle signing step during the Private release train (RC builds, retry/re-run of signing workflow on transient failures, and validation of published signature artifacts). This is required to support air-gapped customer pilots and upcoming GA.

Scope of access (least privilege):
- Allowed: trigger/approve signing workflow runs for Redwood Private offline bundle builds in CI; view signing job status and logs; fetch signed artifact metadata for validation.
- Not allowed: direct access to private signing keys, key export, key material download, KMS/HSM administrative actions, modifying trust roots, or editing signing policy.
- Separation of duties: role does not grant permissions to alter the bundle contents/manifest generation steps or bypass verification gates.

Controls / requirements:
- Access must be granted via group-based assignment (Okta -> RBAC sync), not manual per-system overrides.
- MFA required; access must be auditable (who triggered signing, when, for what build id).
- Expiration + recertification: auto-expire in 90 days; recertify if still needed.

Approvals needed:
- Release Eng lead approval: Connor O'Brien (this ticket)
- Security Eng approval: Marcus Lin
- GRC evidence acknowledgement: Olga Petrov (confirm evidence artifacts are sufficient)

Related work:
- RBAC policy changes in rbac-policy-bundle PR-9441 (least privilege signing operator)
- Break-glass guardrails in rbac-policy-bundle PR-9458 (not requested here)

Evidence to attach/record in ticket:
- Approvals captured in comments
- Group name + role mapping recorded in resolution
- Access start/end date and recertification reminder
comments: 2025-11-06 09:14 Connor O'Brien (reporter): Filing internal request for Devon Price to be added to release-signing-operator for the offline bundle signing rollout. Need this before next RC cut (target 2025-11-13). See scope/controls in description. Tagging Security for approval.

2025-11-06 11:02 Hanae Suzuki (assignee): Acknowledged. I can implement via Okta group -> RBAC sync, but need (1) Security Eng approval, (2) confirmation on duration/expiry, (3) confirmation Devon has completed security training + has hardware-backed MFA enabled. Please confirm.
2025-11-06 11:18 Connor O'Brien: Duration 90 days is fine (pilot + GA hardening). Devon has hardware-backed MFA on Okta. Training: annual security training completed (checked in PeopleOps).

2025-11-07 14:36 Marcus Lin: Security approval granted with conditions: ensure role is limited to workflow invocation + read-only logs; no ability to modify signing policy or access key material. Ensure audit trail includes build id, artifact digest, and requester identity. Also require 90-day expiry and re-certification ticket if renewal requested.

2025-11-07 15:10 Hanae Suzuki: Thanks. I’ll proceed with group-based assignment. Proposed Okta group: okta-redwood-release-signing-operator. RBAC mapping should correspond to rbac-policy-bundle PR-9441 permissions only (no KMS admin).

2025-11-08 10:22 Olga Petrov: GRC note: For evidence, record the group name, approver names, the expiry date, and confirm audit events are emitted for signing workflow actions. This ticket should reference the standard evidence location (Confluence compliance-evidence/offline-bundle-signing-key-ceremony) but no need to attach screenshots here.

2025-11-11 16:05 Hanae Suzuki: Implemented. Added Devon Price to okta-redwood-release-signing-operator; RBAC sync completed. Verified permissions: can trigger signing workflow runs, view job logs, and read signed artifact metadata. Verified cannot access KMS/HSM consoles, cannot view/export signing keys, cannot change signing policy. Set access expiry for 2026-02-09. Audit logging: signing workflow emits operator identity + build id in signing pipeline logs; installer verification events separate (out of scope for this ticket).
2025-11-12 09:27 Connor O'Brien: Confirmed Devon can run the signing workflow in staging and see logs. No additional permissions observed. Thanks—closing.
resolution: Access granted via Okta group okta-redwood-release-signing-operator (RBAC mapping per rbac-policy-bundle PR-9441). Devon Price added 2025-11-11; access expires 2026-02-09; renewal requires new ticket + re-approval (Release Eng + Security).
